verdict.line: You lose this if you eat uncontested Rupture pokes before level 3; you win it by stacking An Acquired Taste into a Q stun and following with Devour.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath's only hard punish window is the Rupture-into-Feral Scream-into-Feast burst starting at level 6, and Thick Skin's stored damage shield is built specifically to eat that burst. Outside of that spike, Tongue Lash's stacking stun and Thick Skin's out-of-combat healing let Tahm Kench out-sustain Cho'Gath's poke, which is why this reads as a 51.5% head-to-head over 194 games with both lane and solo-kill advantage on your side.

theirWindow.what: Feast deals high true damage and grows his max HP (up to 6 stacks) on a kill, so his first all-in with it on 60s cooldown is the one trade that can actually kill you outright.

yourWindow.what: Your next Tongue Lash stuns him and consumes the stacks, so chain W (Abyssal Dive) in off the stun and finish with Devour once he's below three stacks of HP buffer.

start.why: The flat damage reduction on his autoattacks and regen offsets the chip damage from Vorpal Spikes and early Rupture trades; runs 55.8% WR over 165 games at 67.1% pick.

boots.why: Magic resist and tenacity blunt Feral Scream's silence duration and Rupture's slow, at 57.3% WR over 110 games.

core.why: Scales your Acquired Taste passive damage off raw HP while you stack health.
Sets up the standard follow item path with the best measured win rate in this matchup.
Boosted healing stacks with Thick Skin's out-of-combat heal and Devour's sustain; 76.5% WR over 17 games on this exact path.

situational.when: you're ahead and need more sustained teamfight damage instead of pure tank stats
his basic attacks and Vorpal Spikes are chipping you down in extended trades
you're snowballing kills off the Taste-stun early and want to convert the lead faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on autos during extended Thick Skin trades and sustains you through his poke; this page runs 61.2% WR at 53.5% pick.

summoners.why: Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills once a Taste-stun lands; this combo runs 58.9% WR at 63.2% pick, well ahead of Flash+Teleport's 51%.

playing.title: Stack Taste before you commit
playing.detail: Land repeated Tongue Lash hits to build Cho'Gath to 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste before you go for anything real; the 4th hit stuns and consumes them.

playing.title: Dive in right after his Rupture
playing.detail: Rupture is on a 9s cooldown with no secondary use while down, so punish the window immediately after he uses it with Abyssal Dive instead of walking in.

playing.title: Bank E before his level-6 all-in
playing.detail: Thick Skin stores a percent of damage taken while out of combat; stay topped up on stored damage so the active shield is ready the moment he threatens Feast.

playing.title: Keep swinging through Feral Scream
playing.detail: His W silences you for a few seconds in a cone, so don't stand still waiting it out — autoattack through it, since it still builds your passive stacks and damage.

playing.title: Devour the moment stacks are up
playing.detail: Once he's at 3 Taste stacks and you've landed the stun, Devour removes him from the fight for a few seconds, which swings any skirmish decisively in your favor.

playing.title: Don't feed his Feast stacks
playing.detail: Every kill with Feast grows his max HP up to 6 stacks and he only loses half on death, so avoid giving him easy executes on low minions or jungle creatures near you.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 51.5% head-to-head figure are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning about stacking Taste, timing Thick Skin, and dodging Feast is tactical judgment layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid his (Q) when fighting him. Use basic attacks if hit with his (W) and swallow him with [W] afterwards. Use [E] before he uses (R) to avoid being killed when he reaches level 6.
